title: Critical role for a high-plasticity cell state in lung cancer
overall_design: KP mice with either Slc4a11-FSF-MCD/+ with either Hipp11-FSF-GGCB/+ or Rosa26-FSFmTmG/+ reporter alleles or Hopx-FSF-MACD/+ mouse model with either Hipp11-FSF-GGCB/+ or Rosa26-FSF-mTmG/+ alleles were infected by adenoviral CMV-FlpO or lentiviral PGK-FlpO recombinase. Mice with tumors were treated as indicated and tumor cells were hashed with TotalSeq B and then isolated for single-cell mRNA sequencing after FACS purification. One dataset is KP Rosa26-tdTomato/+ with tumors harvested 14 weeks post tumor initiation. One dataset is a KP Slc4a11-MCD/+ iRFP670-GLuc cell line transplant.
Please note that GSM9193561/GSM9193562 are biological replicate of GSM8529536/GSM8529537, sequenced on separate lanes and have different featureref.csv files.
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: KPfrt Slc4a11-MCD/+ Hipp11-GGCB/+ tumor cells harvested 16 weeks PTI after 2 weeks of tracing, GEX
treatment_protocol_ch1: KP mice with either Slc4a11-FSF-MCD/+ or Hopx-FSF-MACD/+ alleles with either Hipp11-FSF-GGCB/+ or Rosa26-FSF-mTmG/+ reporter alleles were infected by adenoviral CMV-FlpO or lentiviral PGK-FlpO recombinase. Mice bearing tumors were treated with either Tamoxifen, Diphtheria toxin, or saline with or without Cisplatin and MRTX1133 as indicated, and tumor cells were isolated, hashed using TotalSeq-B antibodies, and processed for single-cell mRNA sequencing after FACS purification. growth_protocol_ch1: Cells were isolated from animals. No additional growth was involved.
extract_protocol_ch1: Encapsulation and library preparation were performed using the 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3’ Library & Gel bead Kit V3 (10X Genomics, PN-1000121) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Libraries were sequenced using the Nova-Seq 6000 platform (Illumina).
data_processing: FASTQ files of single-cell RNA-sequencing data generated on the 10X Chromium platform were processed using the standard CellRanger pipeline (version >=6.0.0). Reads were aligned to a custom GRCm38 / mm10 reference containing additional transgenes used in the study. The generated cell-gene count matrices were analyzed using a combination of published packages and custom scripts in either the scanpy (v> 1.9.0) / AnnData (v. 0.10.5, Python)
Assembly: GRCm38/mm10
Supplementary files format and content: h5ad

Following QC, the samples were loaded onto Next GEM Chip G (14143, 15123, 15342, 15488, 15600, 15601, 15771) or GEM-X Single Cell Chip (16235, 16318, 16562, 16686, 17402, 17483, 17543) (10X Genomics PN 1000690 & 2000060) and GEM generation, cDNA synthesis, cDNA amplification, and library preparation of ~4-50,000 cells proceeded using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3’ Kit v3.1 or GEM-X Single Cell 3’ Kit v4 (10X Genomics PN 1000268 & 1000691) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. cDNA amplification included 11-12 cycles and 78-863 ng of the material was used to prepare sequencing libraries with 8-14 cycles of PCR. Indexed libraries were pooled and sequenced on a NovaSeq 6000 (14143, 16235, 16562) or X (15123, 15342, 15488, 15600, 15601, 15771, 16235, 16318, 16562, 16686, 17402, 17483, 17543) in a PE28/88 run using the NovaSeq 6000 S4 (200 Cycles) or X 10B (100 Cycles) or 25B (300 cycles) Reagent Kit (Illumina).  An average of 38 thousand paired reads was generated per cell.
data_processing: FASTQ files of single-cell RNA-sequencing data generated on the 10X Chromium platform were processed using the standard CellRanger pipeline (version >=6.0.0). Reads were aligned to a custom GRCm38 / mm10 reference containing additional transgenes used in the study. The generated cell-gene count matrices were analyzed using a combination of published packages and custom scripts in either the scanpy (v> 1.9.0) / AnnData (v. 0.10.5, Python)
